---
title: "Olympics"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

women <- read_csv("female_olympics.csv")

women <- women |> filter(!is.na(Height))

women <- women |> group_by(ID) |> slice(1) |> ungroup()
```

```{r}
women_prop <- sample_n(women, size = 10000)

statkey <- women_prop |> mutate(short = if_else(Height < 160, 1, 0))

short <- women_prop |> filter(Height < 160)

write_csv(statkey, "forstatkey.csv")

confint(women_prop)
```
